spells/touch-of-adamantine-119.name: Touch of Adamantine
spells/touch-of-adamantine-119.effectSummary: Grants one touched weapon the properties of adamantine for 1 minute per caster level. The weapon gains a +1 enhancement bonus on attack rolls, ignores hardness below 20 when striking objects or sundering weapons, and has one-third more hit points than normal. Natural weapons cannot be targeted, except a monk's unarmed strike counts as a weapon for this spell. If the weapon is made from another special material, it loses that material's benefits for the duration. The spell cannot be made permanent with permanency.

provenance.role: Book of Exalted Deeds primary effect and header reviewed; adamantine properties, hardness threshold, hit-point increase, targeting exception, special-material replacement and permanency restriction preserved
